integrity: A self-contained all-size polyhedral/semigroup proof is supported by a deterministic exact-arithmetic Smith-normal-form checker for n=3,4,5,6. The finite computations are not used as the all-size proof. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only the reduced singular locus and transverse normal toric local rings at generic component orbits are determined; the nonreduced Jacobian structure and singularities at component intersections are not classified. Possible equivalent coverage in unindexed toric or statistical-model literature remains a literature risk.
title: Singular linear strata of diagonal-free Segre projections
